title: Karmayogi Bharat, OpenAI Partner to Train Indian Civil Servants in Artificial Intelligence
hook_text: OpenAI is training Indian civil servants.
script:
Karmayogi Bharat partnered with OpenAI to train millions of Indian civil servants in AI.
The state-run public governance platform is rolling out this curriculum for government officers across India.
Public officials at various administrative levels will learn how to leverage machine intelligence.
The collaboration aims to build digital capacity and modern skill sets within public service.
Would you trust a government official using an algorithm to handle your paperwork?
